exposure: Gestational age of 29 weeks or less
finding: The NANO trial aims to determine if empiric antibiotic use at birth in extremely-low-birthweight preterm infants affects the incidence of necrotizing enterocolitis, late-onset sepsis, or death.
mod_finding: The study excluded infants delivered by cesarean section for maternal indications without labor or prolonged rupture of membranes from its analysis.
